decisions.reason: As a multi-model flagship range publicly positioned as central to the firm's direction, the investment and visible commitment make management strongly inclined to persist, and any weak results can still be attributed to pandemic-related disruptions.

A single ESD occupational shoe close to the core offer involves modest investment and no public flagship commitment, so dropping it would be easy, but ESD footwear is a standard requirement in industrial channels and lacking evidence of failure it is likely retained.

A multi-model safety shoe series represents meaningful sunk development and tooling costs within the core business, so management is likely to keep it rather than write off the investment, even though it lacks flagship status.
